title.value: Systematic detection of divergent brain protein-coding genes in human evolution and their roles in cognition
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the document, matching the description of the paper's objective.
title.quote: Systematic detection of divergent brain protein-coding genes in human evolution and their roles in cognition

analysis.description: This paper investigates the evolutionary pressures on human brain protein-coding genes, comparing them with those of early hominins and non-human primates. It identifies genes with significant roles in human cognition and diseases by using datasets of brain single-cell transcriptomics, proteomics, and imaging.

type.justification: The paper uses empirical data and systematic analysis of genetic sequences, employing datasets for quantitative analysis.
